'''Eserine Calmorien''' (751 NE – 993 NE) was an Aes Sedai of the Blue Ajah. She served as a Sitter for the Blue Ajah and later as Keeper of the Chronicles under Amyrlin Seat Noane Masadim. Eserine was born in Cairhien as the illegitimate daughter of Torean Calmorien, a member of the minor noble House Calmorien, and Sarilinne Maloraine, a traveler from Illian.
